results.freedomScoreTooltip: How is the Freedom Score calculated?
results.freedomScoreExplanation: Your Freedom Score (0-100) measures how close you are to your financial independence goal at your target age. A score of 100 means you'll have enough capital to cover your desired income without ever touching the principal.
results.targetCapitalTooltip: Target Capital is the total amount you need to have accumulated to live off your investments. It's calculated from your desired monthly income and the 6% Safe Withdrawal Rate, adjusted for inflation at 2% per year.
results.targetCapitalExplanation: This is the total capital needed so the interest it generates covers your monthly expenses — without ever touching the principal. By targeting this amount, your money works for you indefinitely, like a salary that never stops.
results.withdrawalRateBasis: Based on a 6% safe withdrawal rate per year (adjusted for 2% annual inflation)
results.capitalAtAgeStandardTooltip: Your projected capital at age {{age}} with a standard 6% annual return -- a conservative diversified portfolio estimate.
results.capitalAtAgeManagedTooltip: This is an ambitious target. It requires an Institutional-Grade strategy and a high tolerance for temporary market dips.
results.heatRiskDna: Can you handle this much "Heat"? Discover Your Risk DNA
results.aboveMarketAverage: Aiming for returns {{rate}}% above market average requires an Institutional-Grade strategy.
results.compoundInterestDesc: {{percent}}% of your capital was generated automatically. This is compound interest working for you.
results.compoundNote: This is the power of compound interest. Your money generates gains, and those gains generate further gains. The earlier you start, the more spectacular this effect becomes.

guide.rulesIntro: Calibrated for YOUR profile and YOUR situation

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.identity: You build slowly but surely. Time is your ally — not performance.
glacier.advice1: Build a solid emergency cushion before investing.
glacier.advice2: No need to check your portfolio every week.
glacier.advice3: Beware 'high return, no risk' products — they don't exist.
glacier.rule1: Never more than 25% in equities until your cushion is full.
glacier.rule2: Favour quality bonds and diversified funds.
glacier.rule3: Increase savings rate before increasing risk.

tempere.name: Temperate
tempere.identity: You accept measured ups and downs. You know spring follows every winter.
tempere.advice1: Diversify broadly: regions, currencies, asset classes.
tempere.advice2: Rebalance 1-2× per year to stay aligned with target.
tempere.advice3: If a drop ruins your sleep, you went too high — step down.
tempere.rule1: Don't exceed 50% in equities without a 6-month cushion.
tempere.rule2: Don't check your portfolio more than once a month.
tempere.rule3: Invest the same amount each month (DCA), regardless of the market.

tropical.name: Tropical
tropical.identity: You aim high and absorb hard hits. Volatility is the price of performance.
tropical.advice1: Invest regularly (monthly DCA) rather than big lumps at bad timing.
tropical.advice2: A -20% year is normal for your profile — never panic-sell.
tropical.advice3: Before scaling up risk, secure 6+ months of emergency cushion.
tropical.rule1: Never short-term money (<5 years) in high-volatility equities.
tropical.rule2: Keep at least 25% in bonds as a shock absorber.
tropical.rule3: When markets crash, buy more — never sell.

volcan.name: Volcano
volcan.identity: You chase performance and accept its price. The rule: never panic during eruption.
volcan.advice1: Never invest money you'll need in the next 5 years.
volcan.advice2: Your portfolio will drop -40% at least once in your life — prepare for it now.
volcan.advice3: If drops ruin your sleep, downgrade to Tropical.
volcan.rule1: Keep 12+ months of cushion — volatility must be absorbed without touching capital.
volcan.rule2: Max 10% of portfolio on high-risk bets (crypto, leverage, satellites).
volcan.rule3: Better to earn less than panic and lose everything at the worst moment.
